say:1:1621117001:1.text: You there! What's in your hand? Step forward and comply with the inspection!
say:1:1621117001:1.source_cn: 你手里拿的东西是什么！配合审查！
say:1:1621117001:1.male: You there! What's in your hand? Step forward and comply with the inspection!
say:1:1621117001:1.female: You there! What's in your hand? Step forward and comply with the inspection!

say:2:1621117002:1.text: The crowd thickens around you. To avoid drawing attention, you surrender the package.
say:2:1621117002:1.source_cn: 因周围人群渐多，为了避免骚动，你将包裹交了过去。
say:2:1621117002:1.male: The crowd thickens around you. To avoid drawing attention, you surrender the package.
say:2:1621117002:1.female: The crowd thickens around you. To avoid drawing attention, you surrender the package.

say:4:1621117003:1.text: This... these are magical items from Lyceum students!
say:4:1621117003:1.source_cn: 这……这包裹里装的是莱希拉姆学生的魔力道具……！
say:4:1621117003:1.male: This... these are magical items from Lyceum students!
say:4:1621117003:1.female: This... these are magical items from Lyceum students!

say:5:1621117004:1.source_cn: 等等，你是……莱希拉姆的学生？

say:6:1621117005:1.text: These aren't yours, are they? So why are you carrying so many?
say:6:1621117005:1.source_cn: 这些魔法道具不是你的吧，为什么会有这么多？
say:6:1621117005:1.male: These aren't yours, are they? So why are you carrying so many?
say:6:1621117005:1.female: These aren't yours, are they? So why are you carrying so many?

say:7:1621117006:1.text: Did someone force you to transport them? Don't be afraid, tell me what's going on. I'll protect you.
say:7:1621117006:1.source_cn: 是有人威胁你运的吗？别怕……告诉我怎么回事，我会保护你。
say:7:1621117006:1.male: Did someone force you to transport them? Don't be afraid, tell me what's going on. I'll protect you.
say:7:1621117006:1.female: Did someone force you to transport them? Don't be afraid, tell me what's going on. I'll protect you.

say:8:1621117007:1.text: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.
say:8:1621117007:1.source_cn: 教师的眼神里满是关切，但你心里清楚，若想取得安泽的信任...
say:8:1621117007:1.male: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.
say:8:1621117007:1.female: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.

choice_prompt:9:1621117007.text: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.
choice_prompt:9:1621117007.source_cn: 教师的眼神里满是关切，但你心里清楚，若想取得安泽的信任，就绝不能吐露实情。
choice_prompt:9:1621117007.male: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.
choice_prompt:9:1621117007.female: The teacher's eyes are full of concern, but you know one thing: If you tell the truth, you will lose Anzel's trust.

say:10:1621117008:1.text: If you stay silent, no one can help you. Are you sure about this?
say:10:1621117008:1.source_cn: 如果你什么都不说的话，谁也帮不了你，你确定继续沉默？
say:10:1621117008:1.male: If you stay silent, no one can help you. Are you sure about this?
say:10:1621117008:1.female: If you stay silent, no one can help you. Are you sure about this?

say:11:1621117010:1.text: Professor Mala, this student is acting suspicious. We need to take her back for questioning.
say:11:1621117010:1.source_cn: 莫伊拉老师，这位学生十分可疑，我们要将<male>他<...
say:11:1621117010:1.male: Professor Mala, this student is acting suspicious. We need to take her back for questioning.
say:11:1621117010:1.female: Professor Mala, this student is acting suspicious. We need to take her back for questioning.

choice:9:1:2.text: It has nothing to do with any of you!
choice:9:1:2.male: It has nothing to do with any of you!
choice:9:1:2.female: It has nothing to do with any of you!
